repos_data.description: Make your meetings accessible to AI Agents

A local-first workspace for documents, tasks and meetings on macOS — nested spaces, typed properties, relations and saved views, with transcription, Smart Minutes and an agent running entirely on-device via MLX on Apple Silicon

Free, open-source meeting notes app for Mac: records Zoom, Meet and Teams without a bot, transcribes on-device (whisper.cpp + Breeze ASR 25), identifies speakers, and writes timestamped notes with your own Claude or ChatGPT. 拾音
The free, open-source meeting-notes app for your Mac — offline transcription and AI notes, free in the cloud or 100% on-device.

Your personal context engine for macOS, with Windows and Linux in alpha: on-device meeting notes, screen recall, dictation, and autocomplete that you and your AI agents can search. Free and open source (GPLv3).
Terminal-native call recorder for macOS: system audio + mic, local files, on-device diarized transcription. No bots, no cloud.
Open-source local AI meeting notes for macOS and Windows. Screen recording, timestamp playback, and Ask AI on your computer.
Free, open source call recorder and bot-free AI meeting note taker for Mac: record Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime, WhatsApp and phone calls, get transcripts and meeting notes.

The open-source alternative to Granola. Records your calls on a Mac, transcribes them on your own machine, lets your own AI agent in the terminal (Claude Code, Codex or any other) follow and question a call while it runs, and saves the notes to your own tools. Also runs as a self-hosted transcription server.
Free, open-source AI meeting notes for Mac: transcribes any call and writes the minutes on your Mac. No bot, no cloud, no account.
Local-first CLI and MCP server for meeting transcription, summarization, and provenance — reference implementation of the memnex specification.
Open specification for portable meeting outputs — transcripts, summaries, action items, and decisions
